replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
As a member of the community, you are insightful and incredibly helpful and I appreciate your contributions to the server. I've always seen you as someone who does better casually without duty to corrupt you.

As a staff member, you were quite the opposite. You were too strict, too triggered sometimes, you tryharded, and I found you quite cringy. You tried to be the guardian of the forums which made people not take you seriously and seem like a laughingstock.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
I like you as a person. We used to be the closest duo.

But, you've drifted away from us when we made maps every day. You drifted away from moderating with me and talking to me on TeamSpeak everyday. You started ignoring my messages sometimes, and you became a puppet of the network and a lot of staff will take advantage of you. You do not know how to persuade anyone, and you need to credit others for their work, and to remember your please and thank you.

Also, it helps to show appreciation to the people who work below you. I would tell staff if I were proud of them or not. I would make alerts on how everyone is doing collectively: I haven't seen that from you or posideon.
